columns.name: STDE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the external data record.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Resource the activity is assigned to.

columns.name: KEY_ID_FROM
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Activity Travel key of the source.

columns.name: KEY_ID_TO
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Activity Travel key of the destination.

columns.name: TRAVEL
columns.description: Reported travel time from source to destination.

columns.name: WEIGHT
columns.description: Weightage assigned to the record for computational purposes.

columns.name: USED
columns.description: Boolean showing if the row has already been used by stats agent.

columns.name: ACTIVE
columns.description: Boolean showing if the row can be used for statistics.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
